svg.title: One platform. Different responsibilities.
svg.desc: A logical system view, not a live Azure inventory. Teaching, course authoring and administration have different responsibilities; connected services are source dependencies. Current phase: Services support the interaction. Illustrative timing, not a latency benchmark.
svg.text: Start wide: the people, the learning system, and the services that support it.

g.text: Logical system context / Original source-backed illustration, not a deployed-resource inventory.

svg.text: 03 / The platform uses managed agents, course search, and application storage.
